pipeline and headline with the real name.headline: In a backtest the foundation models may have seen in training, Chronos-2's day-ahead demand forecast had 1.78 times the daily error of NESO's (90% interval 1.68 to 1.88), and a supplier that bought it instead of NESO's would have **clearly gained** (400 £ per GWh of demand, 90% interval 371 to 427); for the weather regression the figure was 0 £ per GWh (0 to 0). Where Chronos-2 disagreed with NESO most (the largest quarter of its disagreements), each MWh of disagreement was worth 20.00 £ (20.00 to 20.00), against 20.00 £ (20.00 to 20.00) in the smallest quarter.
